summary: Completed testing of HR Management Portal - Employee Attendance (late marks) and Sandwich Leave Warning features. All backend tests pass (13/13). Frontend UI tests confirm both features work correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both features tested and working: 1) Attendance page correctly hides late marks section when employee has 0 late marks (April 2026). 2) Sandwich leave warning appears correctly when full week (Mon-Fri) leave is selected, disappears when dates are removed/changed. Backend API /api/leaves/check-sandwich works correctly.

employee_attendance_late_marks.details: Late marks & deduction section correctly hidden when employee has 0 late marks. Salary data API returns late_coming_count=0, late_coming_days=[], late_coming_deduction_days=0, late_coming_amount=0.0 for employee hr@zestbrains.com in April 2026.

sandwich_leave_warning.details: Sandwich warning correctly appears when selecting full week leave (Feb 16-20, 2026 Mon-Fri). Warning shows: 'Your leave in Feb 2026 will trigger sandwich leave rule. Weekend/Holiday dates (14, 15, 21, 22) will be counted as leave days, resulting in additional 4 day(s) salary deduction.' Submit button shows '(Sandwich applies)' text. Warning disappears when dates are removed.

sandwich_no_trigger_single_day.details: Single day leave (Feb 18, 2026) does NOT trigger sandwich warning.

sandwich_no_trigger_half_day.details: Half-day leaves do NOT trigger sandwich warning (verified via backend API test).

check_sandwich_api.details: POST /api/leaves/check-sandwich endpoint returns correct sandwich detection with has_sandwich, sandwich_dates, sandwich_day_count, and warnings fields.
